summary: A phone-friendly ordering site for your pizza shop: customers browse your menu and order for pickup or delivery, and you run the menu, prices and the order queue from your own screens.

people.title: Customers order without an account
people.detail: They pick their pizzas, give a name and phone number, and check out as a guest. Nothing to sign up for, nothing to remember.

people.title: You sign in with a link emailed to you
people.detail: Type your email address, tap the link we send, and you are in. No password. Only addresses you invite can get an account, so nobody else can reach your screens.

people.title: No separate logins for staff
people.detail: You said just you for now. Staff logins can be added later if you want them.

canDo.title: Customers see your whole menu with prices
canDo.detail: Items grouped by category, each with a name, description and price. Built for a phone, one thing at a time.

canDo.title: Pickup or delivery, chosen before checkout
canDo.detail: Delivery asks for an address and postcode; pickup does not even show those boxes.

canDo.title: Delivery only to the postcodes you list
canDo.detail: You keep the list. An address outside it is turned down at checkout, with pickup offered instead.

canDo.title: One delivery fee you set
canDo.detail: Added to every delivery order and shown before the customer pays. You can change it any time.

canDo.title: Menu prices are the final price
canDo.detail: No separate tax line. The total is the items plus the delivery fee.

canDo.title: Card payment through your own Stripe account
canDo.detail: This switches on the moment you connect Stripe — we ask you for the key once the app is built. Until then, checkout still takes the order and marks it pay at the shop, so you are open from day one.

canDo.title: A confirmation page for every order
canDo.detail: Order number, what they ordered, the total, pickup or delivery, and the estimated ready time. The same link keeps showing the status as you move the order along.

canDo.title: New orders land on your screen on their own
canDo.detail: No reloading. Each one shows the items, pickup or delivery, the customer's name and phone, the delivery address, and whether it is paid.

canDo.title: Move an order from received to preparing to ready
canDo.detail: One tap each, then close it off when it has gone out.

canDo.title: Change the menu whenever you like
canDo.detail: Add an item, edit a name, description or price, hide something that has sold out, or remove it. Customers see the change straight away.

canDo.title: Pause ordering when the shop is closed
canDo.detail: Flip one switch and the site shows your message instead of the basket. Flip it back to reopen.

canDo.title: Customer details cleared after twelve months
canDo.detail: Name, phone and address are wiped a year after the order. The order and what was in it are kept, so your history stays intact.

screens.title: Menu
screens.detail: The first thing a customer sees: your items by category, with a basket that follows them down the page.

screens.title: Basket
screens.detail: Change quantities, remove a line, see the total.

screens.title: Checkout
screens.detail: Pickup or delivery, their details, the fee and the final total, then pay.

screens.title: Order confirmation
screens.detail: Order number, summary, estimated ready time, and the live status.

screens.title: Your orders
screens.detail: The live queue, newest at the top, with the buttons that move an order along.

screens.title: Your menu
screens.detail: Add, edit, hide and remove items; change prices.

screens.title: Shop settings
screens.detail: Pause ordering, pickup and delivery switches, delivery fee, your postcode list, and how long pickup and delivery take.

notInThisVersion.title: Building your own pizza
notInThisVersion.detail: You chose a fixed menu, so there is no picking a size, a crust or extra toppings. Each item is one price.

notInThisVersion.title: Ordering for later
notInThisVersion.detail: Every order is for as soon as possible. No picking a time slot.

notInThisVersion.title: Customer accounts and past orders
notInThisVersion.detail: Guest checkout every time, so a customer cannot sign in to see what they ordered last week.

notInThisVersion.title: Messages to customers
notInThisVersion.detail: No texts and no emails when an order is ready — the confirmation page shows the status instead. Email is only used for your own sign-in link.

notInThisVersion.title: Loyalty, several shops, driver tracking and stock
notInThisVersion.detail: All of these you ruled out. The site is built for one shop and does not count ingredients.
